coverImageAlt: A brass magnifying lens and balanced scale resting on layered blank manuscript pages.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A rigorous academic critique represented by a precision magnifying lens examining layered blank manuscript sheets while a small balanced scale tests the evidence.
Scene/backdrop: Warm paper worktable against a quiet slate field with sparse cyan analytical markers made only of geometric shapes.
Subject: One oversized glass lens, several unmarked paper layers, and a balanced brass-and-navy scale arranged as a single coherent still life.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe central still life; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: calm, discerning, scholarly, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: all papers completely blank and unmarked; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
